lines.japanese: 「逃げろ！」
lines.english: “Run!”

lines.japanese: 私はスパロウに叫──
lines.english: I shouted to Sparrow—

lines.japanese: 「逃げて！」
lines.english: “Run!”

lines.japanese: ──いや、私とスパロウが、同時に叫んでいた。
lines.english: —no. Sparrow and I had shouted at the same instant.

lines.japanese: 相手の予期せぬ行動に、私たちは一瞬お互いの驚いた表情を見た。
lines.english: Caught off guard by the other's unexpected move, we exchanged a startled look.

lines.japanese: だが次の瞬間──
lines.english: Then, in the next instant—

lines.japanese: 「ぐっ！」
lines.english: “Guh!”

lines.japanese: 「ううっ！」
lines.english: “Nngh!”

lines.japanese: ──お互いの苦悶の呻きを聞いていた。
lines.english: —each of us heard the other groan in agony.

lines.japanese: 棒の先で首の後ろを突かれたような鋭い衝撃。体の中枢から末端まで稲妻が走った。
lines.english: A sharp impact, like being jabbed in the back of the neck with the end of a pole. Lightning flashed from the center of my body to its every extremity.

lines.japanese: なん……だと……後ろから……？
lines.english: What…? From behind…?

lines.japanese: 視界がぶれる。まずい。鎧を貫通して延髄をやられた。致命傷だ。
lines.english: My vision swayed. This was bad. It had punched through my armor and struck my medulla. A mortal wound.

lines.japanese: 唐突すぎる死の予感に、深く肉をえぐられた痛みさえ現実味が薄い。
lines.english: Death had announced itself too suddenly. Even the pain gouging deep into my flesh seemed unreal.

lines.japanese: 「はねだ、くん……」
lines.english: “Haneda…”

lines.japanese: スパロウの首にも矢が突きたっていた。敵はふたり──それぞれの背後にいたのだ。
lines.english: An arrow stood in Sparrow’s neck as well. There had been two enemies—one behind each of us.

lines.japanese: 「たすけてくれなかったね……」
lines.english: “You didn’t save me…”

lines.japanese: 声が遠い。彼女が弱っているのか、私の感覚が鈍っているのかは分からなかった。
lines.english: Her voice was distant. I could not tell whether she was weakening or my own senses had grown dull.

lines.japanese: そして上空の翼人兵たちはそれぞれ第二矢をつがえる。
lines.english: Above us, the two winged soldiers each fitted a second arrow to the string.

lines.japanese: 「おのれェ……！」
lines.english: “Damn you…!”

lines.japanese: 大聖剣グレタカリバーを支えによろめき立つが、翼を持たぬ私にできるのは、負け犬の目で遥か高みの敵を睨みすえることだけだった。
lines.english: Using the holy greatsword Gretacalibur as a crutch, I staggered to my feet. But without wings, all I could do was glare up at the distant enemy with the eyes of a beaten dog.

lines.japanese: 「ぶっ」
lines.english: “Ghk—”

lines.japanese: 「うぐふっ」
lines.english: “Guhff!”

lines.japanese: 立て続けに胸と喉を射抜かれたが、もはや痛みはなかった。
lines.english: Arrows pierced my chest and throat in quick succession, but by then there was no pain.

lines.japanese: なぜなら僕はここから逃げだしてしまったから。
lines.english: Because I had already fled from that place.

lines.japanese: そうだ。敵うわけがなかったんだ。
lines.english: That was right. I had never stood a chance.

lines.japanese: いつもいつもそうだった。
lines.english: It was always the same.

lines.japanese: 物陰に隠れていても、どんな防具で固めていても、どこまで遠くへ逃げたとしても、やつらはこの空が続くかぎり僕らを追ってきた。
lines.english: No matter where we hid, how heavily we armored ourselves, or how far we fled, they pursued us for as long as the sky stretched overhead.

lines.japanese: そんなとき僕らのポケットにあったのはいつだってペロリチョコ。コイン一枚おいしさ二倍、あの日の夕陽がよみがえる懐かしの甘さ。
lines.english: At times like this, there was always Perori Chocolate in our pockets. One coin, twice the deliciousness—the nostalgic sweetness that brings back that sunset.

lines.japanese: ミルク味も新発売！
lines.english: Now available in milk flavor!

lines.japanese: これは駄目だ。失敗だ。
lines.english: This is no good. It’s a failure.

lines.japanese: いまの夢は見なかったことにしよう。
lines.english: I would pretend I had never dreamed that dream.
